children.text: Given that it’s unclear what x is multiplying, isn’t it all slight of hand?
I hit my weekly limit in 2 days for the first time yesterday. I suspect that this is slight of hand.

The issue was that the original 5x / 20x max plans referred only to multiples of the 5 hour limit - the 20x plan always had only twice the weekly usage of the 5x plan. If anything this is more honest than the original.
The key takeaway for me is that Max 20x is now becoming only 10x, for the same price but without the 5-hour limit. It’s a masterful sleight of hand in the article.

title: Claude 20x is now Ultra without the 5-hour limit
